bullets.text: Police seized 800 kg of gutka hidden in a container lorry during vehicle checks near Gummidipoondi, and the office should monitor enforcement actions.
Police arrested two youths for smuggling ganja on a bus near Gummidipoondi, and the office should track local narcotics control measures.
CMRL announced new names and looks for Phase 2 stations from Poonamallee to Vadapalani to boost revenue, and the office should watch progress.
CapitaLand inaugurated a new data centre in Ambattur, Chennai, in the presence of Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, and the office should track investments.
Canadian Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu stated that Canadian firms want deeper partnerships with Karnataka in AI and quantum computing, and the office should note this.
IIT BHU in Varanasi will host an AI for Healthcare and Assistive Technologies conclave, and the office should watch for technological outcomes.
